Title: Azure Scheduler: P10 and new P20 Premium plans

Body.Content:
The current Azure Scheduler Premium plan has been renamed to P10 Premium, and a new P20 Premium plan has been released. The new P20 Premium plan allows for applications that use large numbers of jobs to support 1000 jobs per job collection. 

To learn more about Scheduler pricing, see Scheduler pricing details.
